shared_elements: animal figure rendered in relief on an upright pillar face
curved/arched linear relief band over the animal
justification: Both surfaces are upright pillar faces carrying animal imagery, and in each a beast's head with a curving band or arc above it appears on the shaft, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A presents several registers of flat, low-relief animals (birds, quadrupeds, a fringed geometric band) crowded across the whole face, while B shows a single animal rendered nearly in the round, projecting from an otherwise bare shaft, so the density, composition and relief conventions differ sharply.
